name: Butterfly Spy
source:
A fairy spy infiltrating a group of insurgents meets a handsome rebel. Will they choose their mission or their heart?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名仙灵间谍潜入反叛者中间，遇上了一位英俊的反抗军成员。间谍会选择完成任务，还是听从自己的心？
